definitionZh: 已知日期通过日、月、年三个单独的字段收集用户已知的日期（生日、护照签发日期、到期日期）。它遵循[英国政府设计系统日期输入模式](https://design-system.service.gov.uk/components/date-input/)：带有标签的“`”包含三个普通的“`元素，用户自己键入每个部分，主机提交一个规范的ISO日期。
sourceDefinition: Known Date collects a date the user already knows — a birthday, a passport issue date, an expiration — through three separate fields for day, month, and year. It follows the [UK Government Design System date input pattern](https://design-system.service.gov.uk/components/date-input/): a labeled ` ` wraps three plain ` ` elements, the user types each part themselves, and the host submits a single canonical ISO date.
